answer: The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, reduced by each unverified claim, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The marble lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the ripple is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Reaching the falcon of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
